text: Hi, this is an AI assistant calling on behalf of Golden Gate Freight accounts payable. This call may be recorded. Am I speaking with dispatch?
Your invoice for load LOAD-4821 includes two hours of detention at the Reno consignee. Our GPS shows the truck on site from 14:02 to 14:49. Can you confirm how long the driver was detained?
Let me check... okay, the driver says he was in and out in about 45 minutes. The detention line was added by mistake.
Thanks. Do you have a detention receipt or a signed in/out time from the facility?
No, we don't have a receipt. Go ahead and pay the linehaul, we'll withdraw the detention.
Understood. We'll pay the linehaul of $1,850 and remove the $300 detention. Thank you.
